rule_audit.name: Landlord obligations
rule_audit.label: Landlord obligations (R.C. 5321.04)
rule_audit.summary: A residential landlord owes statutory duties including compliance with building, housing, health, and safety codes and keeping the premises in a fit and habitable condition.
